items.title: Collect a box of Dandy Boy Apples
items.detail: Check wooden shelves in Vault 51's Shelters Claim Center makeshift kitchen, or use Whitespring Robo Butler Collectron

items.title: Collect a box of InstaMash
items.detail: Find at Vault 51 Shelters Claim Center or the shack west of Mosstown

items.title: Complete the Event: Mischief Night
items.detail: Join at Rapidan Camp, light the pyre, and complete all acts of mayhem with Eyebot JES-2R

items.title: Complete the Quest: Disturbed Grave
items.detail: Finish a public event to receive a Phantom map, then dig up the marked grave

items.title: Eat a box of InstaMash
items.detail: Collect InstaMash and consume it from your Pip-Boy inventory

items.title: Kill a Lost during the Mischief Night Event
items.detail: Join Mischief Night at Rapidan Camp and kill Lost Dwellers that appear during the event

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom
items.detail: Hunt Pint-Sized Phantoms near cabins and campgrounds; listen for child laughter

items.title: Drink Tea
items.detail: Collect Company Tea from a C.A.M.P. generator or find it elsewhere, then drink it

items.title: Kill a Mole Miner
items.detail: Travel to Blackwater Mine for reliable spawns and use V.A.T.S. targeting the head

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom during a Daily Operation while on a Team
items.detail: Join or create a team, enter Daily Ops, and eliminate Pint-Sized Phantoms as enemies

items.title: Kill a Rusted Deathclaw
items.detail: Fast travel to Dino Peaks Mini Golf for three reliable spawns; target the belly with V.A.T.S.

items.title: Kill an Uninvited Pint-Sized Phantom
items.detail: Complete Mischief Night event at Rapidan Camp and wait for the party crasher Phantom to spawn nearby

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Aluminum
items.detail: Craft Bulk Aluminum at a Tinker's Workbench, then scrap it for credit

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Antiseptic
items.detail: Scrap Abraxo cleaner, Industrial solvent, Turpentine, or Tick blood sacs at a workbench

items.title: Sell Mirelurk Queen Steak to an NPC vendor
items.detail: Hunt a Mirelurk Queen at Mac's Farm or Spruce Knob Lake, cook the steak, and sell it

items.title: Travel on foot (KM)
items.detail: Sprint with weapon holstered on open ground to cover 50 km; fast travel does not count

items.title: Complete a Gold Star Daily Challenge
items.detail: Earn the daily Gold Star on three separate days during the week by completing all six other dailies

events.name: The Slasher
events.description: Pint-Sized Phantom cultists appear in the world and during Daily Ops; complete Mischief Night and Disturbed Grave challenges for seasonal rewards.

events.name: Slasher C.A.M.P. Contest
events.description: Build a slasher-themed C.A.M.P. or Shelter and submit entries to the Bethesda Discord for a chance to win atoms and exclusive titles.

events.name: Mischief Night
events.description: Hourly public event at Rapidan Camp where players help an Eyebot commit acts of mayhem and fight Lost Dwellers.

events.name: Minerva's Big Sale (List 4) and Gold Rush
events.description: Minerva offers discounted plans across multiple lists with double gold rewards for completing events.

events.name: Double Mutations
events.description: Increased mutation rates during Daily Operations with new and seasonal rewards available.

events.name: Spooky Scorched
events.description: Modified Scorched enemies spawn with spooky variants offering new seasonal rewards.

events.name: Double XP
events.description: Experience points gain is doubled for all activities during this weekend event.

events.name: Seasonal Fish Run Weekend
events.description: Seasonal fish spawn rates are increased, making it easier to catch rare fishing rewards.
